runtime.note: A single native binary. The host needs no .NET runtime.

commands.name: kgsm
commands.why: resolves instance config and runs the engine's install/update paths
commands.warning: The unit sets Watchdog__KgsmPath=/usr/local/bin/kgsm. A package must never write to /usr/local — packaged, this has to be /usr/bin/kgsm.

commands.name: sh
commands.why: spawns each native server's launch command

commands.name: systemctl
commands.why: owns kgsm.slice and the per-instance cgroups beneath it

commands.name: stat
commands.why: reads cgroup inodes to correlate an instance with its cgroup

commands.name: upnpc
commands.why: opens and closes router port forwards on server start/stop
commands.without: servers start normally and no router forward is created; LAN reachability is unaffected
commands.note: The router must also allow 1900/udp outbound for SSDP discovery.

system.why: native servers are spawned into per-instance cgroups under kgsm.slice
the daemon manages the subtree of kgsm.slice itself
per-instance cpu and memory caps need the controllers enabled on the slice
system.warning: A `systemctl daemon-reload` wipes kgsm.slice's subtree_control when an instance declares memory=0. The daemon re-establishes it, but anything attached to the slice from outside (the monitor's eBPF meter) is lost until re-attached.
